classification.reason: Request is a scientific goal or asks for planning without a concrete workflow.

plan.goal: Generate 2 compact binder backbone candidates against the provided target structure, run basic sequence-level QC on the target chain, and rank the designs by backbone-geometry metrics.
assumptions: rfdiffusion is executed as two independent shards (num_designs: 1 each, max_parallel: 2) in line with the tool's recommended_shard_size of 1
binder_length 70–100 aa is a reasonable compact default; adjust via params if the epitope demands a different size
target_chain defaults to 'A'; supply a different chain letter if the binding interface is on another chain

No hotspot residues are required in this minimal plan; RFdiffusion will diffuse broadly over the target surface — concrete hotspot residue IDs supplied via params.target_hotspots will focus design onto a specific epitope

sequence_analysis is applied to the target FASTA to characterise the interface sequence context (charge, motifs, liabilities); backbone-sequence analysis of the generated binders would require a ProteinMPNN intermediate step not included in this compact plan
rank_designs aggregates rfdiffusion top_candidates and backbone-geometry metrics from both shards; adding ProteinMPNN + AF2 validation would yield richer scoring in a follow-up round
All tools run locally with no cloud GPU inference
missing_inputs: params.target_pdb — path to the target protein PDB file (required for rfdiffusion binder_design mode)
params.target_fasta_path — path to target FASTA file (optional; enables sequence_analysis on the target chain sequence)
